newsitem.title: USA: Judge dismisses Trump N.J. tunnel lawsuit -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Judge dismisses Trump N.J. tunnel lawsuit -- paper.

text.p: A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit by Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc aimed at stopping a $330 million Atlantic City tunnel, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Friday.
In accordance with the federal judge's order, the case instead will be decided by a state judge on May 9.

Trump had argued that state plans to fund the tunnel, including a planned bond sale by the Casino Reinvestment Development Authority, violate the constitutional amendment that brought casino gambling to New Jersey.
The tunnel would improve access to the marina district in Atlantic City, where Trump's rival casino developers are planning major projects.
At issue in Trump's lawsuit is whether the authority is empowered to use casino revenues for projects like the tunnel. Trump said the money can only be used to help the elderly and disabled.
The authority has also asked the state to investigate Trump for anti-competitive behavior in connection with his opposition to the tunnel.
